steps.name: QC and outlier characterization
caveats: Low library size alone does not justify exclusion — check whether sample_01 also separates on PCA/sample-distance before deciding
12000 x 13 counts.csv includes a gene-symbol column; verify it is dropped from the numeric matrix before any computation
steps.question: Does sample_01's low library size (about 4x below median) distort normalization or clustering relative to the other 5 AD-lesional and 6 control samples, and should it be flagged, downweighted, or excluded from the primary DESeq2 model?
acceptance_criteria: Library size distribution reported for all 12 samples with sample_01 explicitly flagged
PCA/sample-distance clustering computed on variance-stabilized counts to check whether sample_01 is an outlier in expression space, not just depth
A documented recommendation (keep with covariate, keep as-is, or exclude with sensitivity check) based on the clustering result

steps.name: DESeq2 differential expression, AD-lesional vs control
caveats: n=6 vs 6 is modest power for a 12000-gene test; note this when interpreting borderline padj genes
Do not drop sample_01 outright without reporting the sensitivity comparison from T1S1's clustering result
Use raw counts as input to DESeq2, not pre-normalized values
steps.question: Which genes are significantly differentially expressed between AD-lesional (n=6) and control (n=6) skin samples using raw Salmon gene-level counts?
acceptance_criteria: DESeq2 run with condition (AD-lesional vs control) as the sole factor, unpaired two-group design, using raw integer counts
Full results table (log2FC, p-value, BH-adjusted p-value) exported for all ~12000 genes
Significant gene list defined at padj < 0.05 (report count) with independent filtering applied
A parallel DESeq2 run excluding sample_01 is produced as a sensitivity check, and the two significant-gene lists are compared for overlap

steps.name: Hallmark pathway enrichment on DE results
caveats: Confirm the hallmark GMT (HGNC symbols) is present in the reference store before running; if absent, report the gap rather than substituting an unrelated collection
Gene symbol matching between DESeq2 output and the hallmark GMT must be exact HGNC symbols; check for version/case mismatches before scoring
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark gene sets are enriched among genes changed between AD-lesional and control skin, using the DESeq2-ranked gene list?
acceptance_criteria: Pre-ranked GSEA (or equivalent rank-based enrichment) run using a rank metric derived from DESeq2 log2FC and p-value, against the MSigDB human hallmark gene set collection (50 sets, HGNC symbols)
Report normalized enrichment score, p-value, and BH-adjusted p-value per hallmark set
Significant hallmark pathways (padj < 0.05) listed with leading-edge genes
Sensitivity: note whether top hallmark pathways change when using the sample_01-excluded DE ranking from T1S2

plan.title: AD lesional vs control DE + hallmark enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Design is 6 atopic-dermatitis-lesional vs 6 control skin samples, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples in counts.csv, 2-column metadata.csv). sample_01 has library size ~4x below median, a QC red flag that can distort size-factor normalization and inflate its dispersion contribution — it is flagged and evaluated (not silently dropped) before the main DESeq2 fit, and a sensitivity re-run excluding it is planned to check robustness of the DE gene list rather than assuming the standard pipeline is unaffected. Track 1 runs QC/outlier characterization then DESeq2 differential expression (treated vs control) on the full raw count matrix. Track 2 takes the DESeq2 output (ranked gene list) and runs hallmark gene set enrichment (GSEA-style, pre-ranked) against the MSigDB human hallmark collection (50 sets, HGNC symbols) confirmed present in the reference store, appropriate for the human skin RNA-seq design. A final synthesis step cross-checks whether the DE gene list and pathway calls are stable to the sample_01 exclusion.
